en.title: Gargoyles Live-Action Series Officially Dead at Disney+
en.summary: The highly anticipated live-action adaptation of the beloved 90s cartoon 'Gargoyles' is no longer moving forward at Disney+. Creator Greg Weisman has confirmed the project's cancellation, dashing hopes for a new generation of fans.
en.body:
The stone has fallen on Disney+'s ambitious plans for a live-action **Gargoyles** series. After initial announcements in 2023 that the project was in early development with writer **Gary Dauberman** and **James Wan**'s Atomic Monster production company, the series has officially been scrapped. The news was confirmed by **Greg Weisman**, co-creator of the original animated series, who stated unequivocally that the project is "dead."

This development brings a premature end to what many fans hoped would be a faithful and thrilling reimagining of the 1990s animated gem. **Gargoyles** captivated audiences with its Shakespearean themes, complex characters, and dark, mature storytelling that set it apart from many other Disney cartoons of its era. The series followed a clan of ancient, nocturnal creatures who were turned to stone by a curse centuries ago, only to be awakened in modern-day New York City, where they must battle to protect humanity from a variety of threats.

The initial announcement had sparked considerable excitement, with many envisioning how the intricate lore and dramatic arcs of **Gargoyles** could translate to a live-action format. The involvement of **Gary Dauberman**, known for his work on the **Conjuring** universe and **It**, alongside **James Wan**'s proven track record in horror and genre filmmaking, suggested a creative team that understood the potential for a darker, more cinematic take.

## The Echoes of Cancellation
The confirmation of the cancellation has sent ripples through the dedicated **Gargoyles** fanbase. For years, fans have expressed a deep desire for new content and a live-action adaptation that could honor the spirit of the original while bringing its unique mythology to a wider audience. The news, while disappointing, is not entirely unexpected for those who have been closely following the project's development. Rumors had been circulating for some time, fueled by the lack of concrete updates and the eventual confirmation from **Weisman** himself.

This decision highlights the often-treacherous path of bringing beloved animated properties to live-action. The balance between honoring the source material and making necessary adjustments for a new medium is a delicate one, and it seems Disney+ ultimately decided not to proceed with this particular iteration. The absence of any announced alternative plans for a live-action **Gargoyles** adaptation leaves the future of such a project uncertain.

## What's Next for Gargoyles Fans
While the live-action series may have turned to stone, the original animated **Gargoyles** remains a cherished part of Disney's legacy. Fans can still revisit the original series on Disney+ to relive the magic of Goliath, Demona, and the rest of the Manhattan Clan. For now, details regarding any future attempts to adapt **Gargoyles** into live-action, or any other new projects related to the franchise, have not yet been announced.
